_howTo: The league's own practice plans, by division. Every coach in a division sees that division's plans at the top of Coaching > Practice Plan and can copy one into their team's plans. Fill in goals (the league's development goals for that level, in the league's words) and plans. A plan is {"id": "majors-wk1", "title": "Week 1: throwing and catching", "focus": "one line on what this practice builds", "blocks": [{"label": "Warm-up / Stretch", "minutes": 10}, {"label": "a drill title from the Drill Library, or any block name", "minutes": 15, "drillId": "optional id from data/practice-catalog-seed.json"}]}. Nothing here is real until the league writes it: empty lists show coaches that plans are coming.
